verification_methodology.disclosure: Coffee beans are modeled as discrete free-body rigid bean parcels (36 calibrated 1.0 g free ellipsoids inside the hopper above a hinged MuJoCo slide/flap gate). Total mass is strictly conserved across hopper bin, weighing cup, and catch tray; first-hit body is logged per parcel.
